AWS-8 remained on Okinawa as part of the garrison force following the Surrender of Japan.  The squadron departed Okinawa for the United States in February 1946 and was quickly decommissioned upon its arrival in California.  To date, no other Marine Corps squadron has carried the lineage and honors of AWS-8 to include Marine Air Control Squadron 8 (MACS-8).
